title: Restart {{kind}} {{name}}?
intro_other: These {{count}} objects are restarted one at a time, in this order. Each request is sent once.
sharedController_one: {{count}} of these pods belongs to {{controller}}. Deleted back to back, they can take the workload down until the new pods are ready.
sharedController_other: {{count}} of these pods belong to {{controller}}. Deleted back to back, they can take the workload down until the new pods are ready.
waitShared: Delete the pods of one controller one at a time, each after the new pod is Ready (up to 5 minutes each)

step.rollout: {{name}}: its pods are replaced one by one (rollout restart).
step.argoRollout: {{name}}: Argo Rollouts replaces its pods one by one (kubectl argo rollouts restart).
step.owner: {{name}} is restarted in place of its ReplicaSet {{replicaSets}}: its pods are replaced one by one. A ReplicaSet of a Deployment or Rollout cannot be restarted on its own.
step.pods: {{name}} has no owner: its pods are deleted one at a time and the ReplicaSet creates a new pod for each. The next pod is deleted only after the new one is ready; if it is not ready in 5 minutes, the other pods are left as they are.
step.pod: {{name}} is deleted, and its {{controller}} creates a new pod in its place.

templatePatch: Sent to each Deployment, StatefulSet and DaemonSet as a merge patch, with the time of sending (UTC):
argoPatch: Sent to each Rollout as a merge patch, with the time of sending (UTC):
progressPods_one: {{name}}: {{done}} of {{count}} pod restarted, waiting for the new pod to be ready…
progressPods_other: {{name}}: {{done}} of {{count}} pods restarted, waiting for the new pod to be ready…
summaryStopped: Stopped: {{done}} of {{total}} restarted; the rest were not started.
disconnected: The cluster disconnected: the restart stops after the current step.

error.replaced: {{name}} was replaced by another object of the same name since the list was shown. Nothing was sent.
error.deleting: {{name}} is being deleted. Nothing was sent.
error.ownerChanged: The owner of {{name}} changed since the list was shown. Nothing was sent.
error.paused: {{name}} is paused: a restart would not roll out. Resume it first.
error.notReady: The new pod in place of {{name}} was not ready within 5 minutes. The other pods were left as they are.
error.listTimeout: The pods of the ReplicaSet could not be listed within 5 minutes.
error.earlierNotReady: Not deleted: the new pod in place of an earlier pod of {{controller}} was not ready.
